request_state.conjecture: Beal: A^x + B^y = C^z with x,y,z >= 3 and gcd(gcd(A,B),C) = 1 has no solutions. Audit has shown three recurring failure modes in this project: conflating a residual mod-p congruence with an isogeny or l-adic statement; using a Chabauty rank bound over a base field to conclude about points of higher degree; and relabelling a GRH-conditional or heuristic result as unconditional.

candidate_A.claim: C171 UNDERSTATED THE OBSTRUCTION. The three-exponent rigid Q-rational object is never REGULAR. Regularity (distinct Hodge-Tate weights, required by every potential-automorphy theorem available in rank > 2) means partition (1^n) at both 0 and infinity; those contribute n+n, so rig = 2 forces the third puncture to contribute n^2-2n+2, i.e. the pseudoreflection (n-1,1); and a pseudoreflection is Q-rational only when phi(m) = 1, i.e. m <= 2, excluded by the Beal exponent range. So automorphy is not merely unproved for this object -- the regular-weight family of theorems cannot apply to it however much it is strengthened.
candidate_A.method: Exhaustive exact enumeration, code/U317_regularity_obstruction.py: of 792 rigid Q-rational triples with three pairwise distinct reduced exponents at ranks 2..14, ZERO are regular at both 0 and infinity; and (n-1,1) is Q-rational for NO reduced exponent at any rank 3..8. Self-duality was checked too and is free: a Galois orbit over Q is closed under alpha -> alpha^(-1) because -1 is coprime to m, so only regularity bites.
candidate_A.evidence: Arithmetic core machine-checked in formal/Beal/Rigidity.lean: regular_forces_pseudoreflection (rigidityIndex n (n+n+s) = 2 iff s = n^2-2n+2), pseudoreflection_budget, rational_pseudoreflection_order_le_two (via Nat.totient_eq_one_iff), no_rational_pseudoreflection_for_exponent. #print axioms = [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; full lake build clean.
candidate_A.failure_reason: BLOCKED. Two independent obstructions now, not one: (1) automorphy of rank-n motives over Q for n > 2 is unproved (C171); (2) the object is irregular, so the regular-weight potential automorphy theorems are structurally inapplicable to it (this candidate). (2) is the harder of the two because strengthening the existing theorems does not help.
candidate_A.obligations: NOT formalised: the step from 'local system defined over Q' to the combinatorial model of Galois-stable multiplicity vectors, and the identification of regularity with partition (1^n) at 0 and infinity. Both are standard but are modelling assumptions here. ESCAPES NOT TESTED: non-rigid families (moduli dimension (n-1)(n-2)), base fields larger than Q, irregular-weight automorphy (Calegari-Geraghty style) which is exactly the hard open direction, and objects that are not local systems at all.
candidate_A.novelty: Corrects my own C171 from 'one missing theorem' to 'a structural mismatch plus a missing theorem'. That is a sharper and more useful statement of why the survey's first live direction is open. It is not progress toward a proof of Beal.

evaluations.U317: Exhaustive exact enumeration plus four machine-checked lemmas. HYPOTHESIS_ONLY for routing.
evaluations.escape_1_closed_U318: First named escape CLOSED by U318/C175: the obstruction does not use rigidity at all. The rank of a regular Q-rational monodromy of order m lies in [phi(m), m], and for three pairwise distinct reduced exponents those intervals are disjoint. Remaining escapes: larger base fields, irregular-weight automorphy, non-local-system objects.
evaluations.escape_2_open_U319: SCOPE CORRECTION from U319/C176: this obstruction is about Q only. The larger-base-field escape is real and cheap -- a field of degree 2 to 6 already reconciles the ranks for every pairwise distinct triple of reduced exponents up to 19. Do not state the regularity obstruction as field-independent. It still does not give a route, because over K the method needs automorphy in rank > 2 over K (C171), which is harder than over Q.

candidate_B.claim: The regularity obstruction of C174 does NOT depend on rigidity, so C174's first named escape (non-rigid families) closes. Over Q, regular semisimplicity at a puncture of order m forces the rank to satisfy phi(m) <= n <= m, because the eigenvalue multiset is a union of whole Galois orbits taken once and sum over d | m of phi(d) = m. For three pairwise distinct reduced exponents p < q < r the largest must be an odd prime, so phi(r) = r-1 > p >= n, and the three intervals cannot meet.
candidate_B.method: Exact enumeration of the rank sets S(m) = {sum of phi(d) over divisor sets containing m}, code/U318_regularity_without_rigidity.py. All 165 pairwise-distinct triples from {3,4,5,7,11,13,17,19,23,29,31} give an empty intersection. CONTROLS: (p,p,p) is non-empty for every p, and the mixed cases (3,3,4) -> ranks {2,3} and (4,4,5) -> rank {4} are non-empty, so the test is not vacuous. No rigidity index appears anywhere in the criterion.
candidate_B.evidence: Machine-checked in formal/Beal/Rigidity.lean: regular_rank_upper (Nat.sum_totient), regular_rank_lower (phi(m) <= n whenever the multiplicity at m is at least 1), no_common_regular_rank (for r an odd prime with p + 2 <= r, no n satisfies both n <= p and phi(r) <= n). #print axioms = [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; full lake build clean.
candidate_B.obligations: Same modelling caveat as C174 and NOT formalised: the step from 'local system defined over Q' to the Galois-stable multiplicity model, and the identification of regular Hodge-Tate weights with regular semisimplicity at every puncture. ESCAPES STILL UNTESTED: base fields larger than Q (where the Galois orbits are smaller and the intervals widen), irregular-weight automorphy of Calegari-Geraghty type, and objects that are not local systems on the thrice-punctured line.
candidate_B.novelty: Turns C174 from a statement about rigid objects into a statement about ALL local systems on P^1 minus three points over Q. The obstruction is arithmetic (totient intervals), not geometric (rigidity budget) -- which is why dropping rigidity buys nothing. Not progress toward a proof.

evaluations.U318: Exhaustive exact enumeration with non-vacuity controls plus three machine-checked lemmas. HYPOTHESIS_ONLY for routing.
evaluations.escape_2_open_U319: SCOPE CORRECTION from U319/C176: this obstruction is about Q only. The larger-base-field escape is real and cheap -- a field of degree 2 to 6 already reconciles the ranks for every pairwise distinct triple of reduced exponents up to 19. Do not state the regularity obstruction as field-independent. It still does not give a route, because over K the method needs automorphy in rank > 2 over K (C171), which is harder than over Q.

compatible.instructions: Are these two research candidates mathematically COMPATIBLE, in the sense that the objects, fields, exponents and equations they concern are the same or are related by a reduction that the project has already proved?

criteria.true: they concern the same equation, signature, curve or field, or one supplies an input the other consumes
criteria.false: they concern unrelated equations, signatures or methods, so no joint statement could be formed without inventing a new reduction

combination_value.instructions: If these two candidates were combined into a single line of attack, how much would the combination accomplish beyond what the better of the two accomplishes alone?
criteria: level 0: nothing; the combination is just the stronger candidate restated, or they are incompatible
level 1: the combination tidies bookkeeping but resolves no obligation that either one leaves open
level 2: one candidate discharges a specific open obligation recorded in the other
level 3: the combination closes a case or an infinite family that neither one closes alone

shared_failure.instructions: Would these two candidates FAIL FOR THE SAME REASON, so that combining them adds no diversity of failure mechanism and a single obstruction would defeat both?

criteria.true: both depend on the same blocked step, the same unverified citation, or the same one of the three recorded failure modes
criteria.false: they would fail for different reasons, so each provides genuine independent information
